name: agentclip
description: Capture your AI agent's QA runs as shareable clips. Returns a single URL with screenshots, captions, and a summary.

tools.name: slideshow_create
tools.description: Start a new slideshow. Returns id, share_url, and a write_token used to mutate this slideshow.

tools.name: slideshow_add_slide
tools.description: Append a screenshot and caption to an existing slideshow.

tools.name: slideshow_update_slide
tools.description: Replace the image and/or caption of a slide already in the slideshow.

tools.name: slideshow_set_summary
tools.description: Set the slideshow's TL;DR. Call once near the end of a run.

AGENTCLIP_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the AgentClip backend. Defaults to https://agentclip.dev.

AGENTCLIP_STATE_PATH.description: Path to the local write_token state file. Defaults to ~/.agentclip/state.json.
